findings.claim: Analyzer diagnostics for metadata-only generic types are now suppressed in the consuming compilation rather than emitted without a valid source location. This matches the deliberate ownership model: the defining assembly validates and formats its own types, so the absence of MsgPack004 and similar diagnostics in the consumer is not a regression.

receipt_plan.detail: [L8] Referenced-assembly types are deliberately not analysed by the consuming compilation; the defining assembly owns their validation and formatting. The README and MsgPack004 documentation additions are consistent with this decision.
